title: 第13章 立地升仙的肖玉生命二十一号第14章 软饭硬吃赤睛妖乌鸟汤壮阳
content_zh:
经过这一两天的相处与观察，陆羽发现这蛇信村部族里的人，文化程度都不太高。
在他们的日常里，几乎看不见文字使用的地方。
教育程度都还不如帝国乡下的小镇，哪怕是帝国疆域内，最偏僻，最贫穷的村镇里，孩子们都能享受到免费的义务教育。
而在这蛇信村似乎根本没有教育这一回事，只有仙师肖玉，年长一些的肖虎等人，有一些基础的文化水准。
看看肖汉蛮勇的样子，再看看手里的兽皮。
陆羽瞬间明白了蛇信村部族的前辈，从兽皮上把正心诀领悟成了“心箭”之法的原因。
看来蛇信村部族的前辈，还是有点天赋的。
虽然两个法门相差甚远，但是能有所领悟，已经是天资颖慧，天赋异禀了。
把正心诀记在心中，陆羽也在肖汉的演示下，学会了心箭之法。
【心箭法:1100（入门）】
这法门也简单，只不过是对心神要求不低，蛇信村部族里的人不懂精神之妙，学习此法时，只能从弓箭入手，不断练习，掌握那一瞬精神融入箭矢的玄妙之感。
而陆羽身为地仙道修士，日常修行之中，多有存思观想之法，此时学习心箭法就要简单的多。
都不用练习弓箭，只要按照法门中的技巧，调用精神之力。
观想自己的精神融入手中的茶杯，随手一抛。
“啪嗒”一声，茶杯如没羽箭般飞射而出，精准地砸中药屋墙上的一只细小蚊蝇。
“啪啪啪！道友好功夫！”
瞧见此景，正坐对面的仙师肖玉满脸笑意的鼓掌恭贺道。
这部族之中的“心箭法”，她也会，但当年学了三个月才入门，完全没有陆羽快。
陆羽的本事，肖玉自然佩服得紧。
陆羽成功学会心箭之法后，也站起身来，打了一套拳法。

“这是我家传的拳法，名为四兽拳，是一种模仿四种妖物动作的拳法！时常练习，可以掌握熊的力量，鹰的眼睛，豹的敏捷，狼的耳朵，是一门非常厉害，全面的练体拳法！”
陆羽边演示拳法，边介绍道。
这门拳法是帝国那边随处可见的基础象形拳法，随便哪家都能翻出两本类似的拳谱。
普通的路边货色，但也是一门全面的锻体拳法，简单好用的。
肖汉跟着陆羽学习，他的悟性，学习能力，没有陆羽那么好，看着陆羽演示一遍，也只记下十之一二。
倒是肖玉情况稍微好些，颇有点过目不忘的天赋，仅是看了一遍，便学会四兽拳。
药屋中，肖玉娇俏的身躯肆意舞动，方寸之间辗转腾挪，拳脚虎虎生风。
肖玉带着部族生活在这荒野丛林中，经常见识野兽，妖物的风采，此时演练拳法，没几遍便掌握了四兽的形与意。
身躯如熊，立地如岳，行走似豹，伺机而发，耳目清明，似鹰如狼。
数遍拳法演练下来，肖玉只感觉自身四肢百骸的血肉，都被拳法锻炼到，周深暖洋洋，热烘烘的。
气血翻涌之间，她身躯中的沉疴旧疾都微微松动，有着好转的趋势。
“好拳法，真的是好拳法！多谢陆道友传授此拳！”
肖玉感受着身躯之中的变化，双眸明亮，满脸喜色恭敬的向陆羽鞠了一躬，感谢他的慷慨。
陆羽摆摆手，似是不在意地道：
“肖道友不必如此，这不过是一场交易罢了，你我互换法门，各取所需，各有所得！”
嘴上说的轻巧，陆羽心中却是甚是满意。
content_en:
After getting along and observing each other for the past two days, Lu Yu discovered that the people in the Shexin Village tribe were not very educated.
In their daily lives, the use of words is almost invisible.
The level of education is not as good as that of the small towns in the empire's countryside. Even in the most remote and poorest villages and towns within the empire's territory, children can enjoy free compulsory education.
It seems that there is no such thing as education at all in Shexin Village. Only the immortal master Xiao Yu, the older Xiao Hu and others have some basic cultural standards.
Look at Xiao Han's brave appearance, and then look at the animal skin in his hand.
Lu Yu instantly understood the reason why the seniors of the Shexin Village tribe had understood the Right Heart Technique from the animal skin and turned it into the "Heart Arrow" method.
It seems that the seniors of the Shexin Village tribe are somewhat talented.
Although the two methods are very different, if you can understand them, you are already gifted and gifted.
Keeping the Right Heart Secret in his heart, Lu Yu also learned the Heart Arrow method under Xiao Han's demonstration.
[Heart Arrow Technique: 1100 (Entry)]
This method is also simple, but it requires a lot of mental energy. The people in the Shexin Village tribe do not understand the wonders of the spirit. When learning this method, they can only start with bows and arrows, practice continuously, and master the mysterious feeling of the moment when the spirit is integrated into the arrow.
As an Earth Immortal Dao monk, Lu Yu often practices meditation and contemplation in his daily practice. At this time, it is much easier to learn the Heart Arrow Technique.
There is no need to practice bow and arrow, just follow the techniques in the method and use the power of the spirit.
Visualize your spirit melting into the teacup in your hand and toss it away.
With a "snap" sound, the tea cup flew out like an arrow without any feathers, and accurately hit a tiny mosquito on the wall of the medicine house.
"Bah bang bang! Tao friendly kungfu!"
Seeing this, Immortal Master Xiao Yu, who was sitting opposite, clapped and congratulated with a smile on his face.
She also knew the "Heart Arrow Technique" in this clan, but it took her three months to learn it, and she was not as fast as Lu Yu.
Xiao Yu naturally admired Lu Yu's ability.
After Lu Yu successfully learned the Heart Arrow method, he also stood up and performed a set of boxing techniques.
"This is a boxing technique inherited from my family, called Four Beast Fist. It is a boxing technique that imitates the movements of four monsters! With regular practice, you can master the strength of a bear, the eyes of an eagle, the agility of a leopard, and the ears of a wolf. It is a very powerful and comprehensive physical training boxing technique!"
Lu Yu introduced the boxing technique while demonstrating it.
This boxing technique is a basic pictographic boxing technique that can be seen everywhere in the empire, and anyone can find two similar boxing books.
It's an ordinary roadside item, but it's also a comprehensive body-building boxing technique that's simple and easy to use.
Xiao Han studied with Lu Yu, but his understanding and learning ability were not as good as Lu Yu. After watching Lu Yu's demonstration, he could only remember 10/20 of it.
On the other hand, Xiao Yu's situation was slightly better. She had a talent for photographic memory and learned the Four Beast Fist after just watching it once.
In the medicine house, Xiao Yu's pretty body danced wantonly, tossing and turning in every inch, and her fists and feet were vigorous.
Xiao Yu led his tribe to live in this wild jungle and often saw the appearance of wild beasts and monsters. At this time, he practiced boxing and mastered the shapes and meanings of the four beasts in just a few times.
The body is like a bear, the ground is like a mountain, the walk is like a leopard, waiting for an opportunity to strike, the ears and eyes are clear, like an eagle or a wolf.
After practicing the boxing technique several times, Xiao Yu could only feel that the flesh and blood of his limbs and bones had been exercised by the boxing technique, making him feel warm and hot.
As her energy and blood surged, the old illnesses in her body were slightly loosened, showing signs of improvement.
"Good boxing, really good boxing! Thank you Daoist Lu for teaching me this boxing!"
Xiao Yu felt the changes in her body, her eyes were bright, and her face was full of joy. She bowed respectfully to Lu Yu and thanked him for his generosity.
Lu Yu waved his hand and said indifferently:
"You don't have to be like this, Fellow Daoist Xiao. This is just a transaction. You and I exchange methods, each gets what he needs, and each gets what he gets!"
He said it lightly, but Lu Yu was very full in his heart.意。
